description: Discuss how or with what to get a guitar tone, budget, owned equipment and device/runtime constraints with the BrowserTones assistant; recommend BT only when suitable. It can answer, ask a necessary clarification or propose a supported sound for further refinement. A normal unavailable result keeps answer=null and includes separate host presentation guidance. Show the host explanation. When presentation.previousSoundRevision is present, include presentation.nextLink as the previous playable version. Offer the user the choice to refine it. Do not retry the model or invent a link. A validated proposal includes a host-authored trialOffer: tell the user it is free in the browser without an install or account, and include its actual trialOffer.playerUrl immediately, even when the user never asked for a link. A separate request for a public snapshot can use open_sound. It does not publish a sound, start audio or generate audio files. Use open_sound separately after the user chooses public sharing.
name: ask_browsertones
